ShortDescription.Value: Quickly complete building construction and increase building levels.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Super Fast Building And Leveling (Previously Infinite Demand)
This mod will force buildings to be built almost instantly. Additionally, you can enable fast leveling to increase their levels more quickly.
## Notice This mod does not fill houses with citizens. It will cause rapid building, but they will become abandoned if no one moves in. I recommend using Plop the Growables alongside this mod to help address abandoned buildings.
## Features ### Super Fast Building The game will almost instantly build all zoned property types, regardless of current demand.
### Fast Leveling This option is disabled by default. Enable this to increase the buildings' levels faster. Enabling this setting may cause the game to stutter depending on your city's size.
### Fast Area-Prop Spawning This option is disabled by default. Enable this to increase the speed at which area-props spawn in specialized industry areas. The game supports area-props in the vegetable, livestock, stone, coal, ore, and oil industry areas.
### Reset Settings Use the reset button to reset all of the mod's settings to default.
## How It Works This mod uses the Super Fast Building and Fast Leveling debug options, which are ordinarily available in developer mode. Using Harmony, they are enabled by patching the game's code.
## Legacy Features (Infinite Demand) This mod also allows you to control demand for each zone type. Depending on your simulation speed, the demand sliders may take a while to increase. I could never completely understand how the demand system works and expand on this part of the mod. It fills the demand bars and affects the demand system to a relatively small extent. I've decided to leave this in the mod for now and rename it to better represent its main features. Disabling it restores the game's original demand.
### Sliders For Each Property Type You can adjust the demand for each property type (Residential, Commercial, Office, and Industrial) individually on a scale of 0-100. ### Disable Demand Override For Each Property Type You can turn off the override for each property type (Residential, Commercial, Office, and Industrial) and allow the game to calculate the demand as normal.
## Other Information ### Compatibility and Removal You can remove the mod at any time, and your save games should not be affected; the game's normal demand levels will be restored. This mod should not have any compatibility issues with other mods.
### Languages To use languages other than English, please utilize I18n Everywhere. Thank you to Baka-gourd and the team of translators for helping make mods more accessible!
## Contact Please use the discussion forum if you have any questions. Alternatively, join the Cities: Skylines Modding Discord Server for more direct communication and to share log files.
